episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: A handsome heir of the royal family is attending art school. A spunky classmate whose parents are in debt overhears a private conversation of the prince.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The future princess is being chased by reporters. Another prince comes back to town and enrolls at the art school.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The future princess begins her lessons to learn the customs of the palace. The wedding ceremony is broadcast on live TV.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The princess goes back to school with bodyguards. The prince's former girlfriend gets a scholarship offer.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The crown princess's parents visit the palace. There's a party for the crown prince's birthday on Jeju Island.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: The crown princess learns more customs of the palace. She appears at her first public event with her husband, but someone tries to wreck it.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: The royal couple goes to stay with the crown princess's family for a few days, but no one can agree on the sleeping arrangements.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: The crown prince's ex-girlfriend starts to get friendly with the crown princess, but it's all part of her plan.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: The crown prince goes to Thailand and gets an unexpected visitor, while the crown princess stays behind in Seoul.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: The crown prince wraps up his Thai adventure, while the palace welcomes Prince William on his visit.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Another princess arrives at the palace. Photos emerge from the crown prince's rendezvous in Thailand.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: The empress dowager makes a final decision about the royal hierarchy. The crown princess goes on a trip for a charity event.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Yul begins to gain a fanbase as the Empress Dowager attempts to squash bad rumors of Shin and Chae Kyung by having them share a bed.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Everyone is wondering what happened during the prince and princess's night together. Yul makes a confession.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: The crown prince's actions have gotten him in trouble. The entire royal family comes together for dinner.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: The crown prince and princess have a romantic getaway. Hyo Rin is more upset than anyone realized.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.summary: The empress makes Hyo Rin an offer. Prince Ee Sung starts to take on more responsibility.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.summary: Drama gets stirred up at Prince Ee Sung's birthday party. Chae Kyung tries to play a prank on Shin.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.summary: The crown prince finds out something about the emperor and Lady Hwa Young. The crown princess gets in trouble again.

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.summary: The crown princess is involved in a media scandal of her own. The crown prince confronts Lady Hwa Young.

episodes.title: Episode 21
episodes.summary: The royal couple wraps up the TV interview. The crown princess goes on a hunger strike.

episodes.title: Episode 22
episodes.summary: The royal family is reeling from Yul's confession. The crown princess is seriously considering leaving the palace.

episodes.title: Episode 23
episodes.summary: After the fire, the royal family tries to find out what happened and why. Yul feels heartbroken.

episodes.title: Episode 24
episodes.summary: The crown princess gets ready to go abroad, while the crown prince awaits his summons.
